rows.grounds: digbandhana = direction-binding; accusative object of prakurvīta
optative of root kṛ; action commanded for the sādhaka
choṭikābhiḥ + anantaram fused; instrumental plural feminine with indeclinable afterwards

items.question: What should the excellent practitioner do after displaying the invocation, placement, and covering mudrās?
premises: The sādhaka has shown āvāhanī and sthāpanī mudrās.
The sādhaka has also shown avaguṇṭhana mudrā.
items.inference: After those mudrās, the practitioner should perform digbandhana with choṭikās.
uncertainties: The exact ritual force of choṭikās is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: Afterwards, the excellent practitioner should perform direction-binding with choṭikās.
